needs_restart.title: Home Assistant needs to be restarted
needs_restart.description: CA {ca_filename} with Common Name {common_name} is missing in Home Assistant's SSL Context. Restart Home Assistant to reload it.

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant now?
confirm.description: This will restart Home Assistant so the certificate {ca_filename} (Common Name {common_name}) can be reloaded into the SSL Context.
